title: A TRADE THAT FAILS SAYS WHY
why: From the trade audit of 2026-10-03: an offer to a downed teammate hung until it ran out, an offer nobody answered vanished without a word on either side, and a refused offer left the giver line open. Now a downed receiver refuses at once with the reason, a refused offer closes on both sides with the reason said, an offer that ran out says so to the receiver, and one nobody took says so to the giver.
now: When a trade does not go through, both players are told why: down, gone, ran out or not taken.
